title: Finish In Balance Hold The Pose (Chas McIvor)
style: country swing bluegrass banjo brass bongo fast beat 130bpm comedy dad voice spoken interjections southern drawl harmonica steel guitar
lyrics:
[Intro - Chas spoken]
I say son, the swing aint done at impact
Finish in balance, hold the pose, thats a fact
If you cant hold it, you swung too hard

[Verse 1]
Weight ninety percent on the lead foot at finish
Trail toe pointing down, heel up, dont diminish
Belt buckle facing the target full
Chest rotated, eyes follow the pull

[Pre-Chorus]
Hold the finish three seconds, son
If you wobble or fall, you overdid the run
Balance is the report card of the swing
Good swing, good balance, the bell will ring

[Chorus]
Finish in balance, hold the pose, son
Three second freeze, the work is done
Lead foot ninety, trail toe down
Belt buckle target, wear the crown of the round

[Verse 2]
If you fall back you came over the top
If you fall forward you slid through the stop
If you fall left you swung too steep
Diagnose from balance, son, dont weep

[Bridge - Chas spoken]
I say boy, every range session
Finish every swing in balance, the lesson
Hold three seconds, every single time
Balance becomes habit, balance becomes prime

[Chorus]
Finish in balance, hold the pose, son
Three second freeze, the work is done
Lead foot ninety, trail toe down
Belt buckle target, wear the crown of the round

[Outro]
Hold the pose, three counts
Balance shows what the swing recounts
Lead foot loaded, belt buckle through
Thats my boy, thats your view
